name: Louisiana Department of Agriculture and Forestry

grants.description: The purpose of this agreement is to allow state and territory governments to purchase local, unprocessed or minimally processed domestic foods from local producers, targeting historically underserved farmers/producers/fishers and small businesses including processors, aggregators, and distributors.
